messages:
maria: Quick favor — can someone run a tiny torch.profiler + nsys sample for the stepcount regression? I can only repro on A100-40GB in staging.
leo: I have a 30m window. what's the exact command + input so we don't waste time?
maria: Thanks! Use this nsys wrapper for a 30s capture:
```nsys profile -o /tmp/prof_run --trace=cuda,cublas,osrt -t 30 -- python -m my_app --batch 2 --seq 1024```
And the torch.profiler snippet: 
```with torch.profiler.profile(activities=[torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CPU, torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CUDA], record_shapes=True) as p:
    model(input)
    p.key_averages().export_chrome_trace('torch_trace.json')
```
Save the nsys `.qdrep` + `.nsys-rep` and the chrome trace.
sam: Can you capture KV cache warmup too? Add `--kv-warmup-steps=3` and run a single prompt with a repeated prefix so we exercise the cache.
maria: Yes — add `--kv-prefix 'warmup'` and capture the first 8 tokens. I'll redact any secrets before sharing.
devon: @leo if you run it can you upload artifacts to S3 path `s3://redwood-perf/prof/1738200000-maria` and ping me? Include machine info and git sha.
leo: On it. I'll include nsys qdrep, the torch `torch_trace.json`, a small `metadata.txt` (GPU, driver, CUDA, git sha), and a `run.cmd` with exact args. ETA ~45m.
perf-bot: perf-bot: Upload link will be created once artifacts land: s3://redwood-perf/prof/1738200000-maria (auto-expire in 7d)
sam: :thumbsup: also run a short baseline with `--batch 1` so we can compare per-token latency vs the batch=2 run.
maria: Added. If anyone has a quick flamegraph helper script drop it here; otherwise I'll open speedscope on the chrome trace.
leo: I have a small helper: `python tools/flamegraph/trace_to_flame.py torch_trace.json > flame.svg` — will attach the svg after upload.
maria: Awesome — once uploaded I'll post a tiny before/after table (p50/p95 tokens/s) and mark suspected kv-miss windows. Thanks everyone :heart:

leo: Upload done — artifacts at https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-perf/prof/1738200000-maria (same path). Baseline run included. Noted a latency spike at step 12 in nsys timeline; added a note in metadata.txt.
maria: Received. Starting analysis now. If it's a KV miss we can try devon's prefetch branch next.
devon: I'll queue a small branch `kv-prefetch/quick` with a microtest. If maria's analysis points to misses I'll push a patch and a tiny perf run.
perf-bot: perf-bot: Analysis checklist created: /playbooks/profiling/checklist-1738200000.md
